releases.notes:
Version 1.0.1 Update Released

This update fixes a series of bugs. A button has been added to the exchange that allows you to remove your own listed items. A new command, /shop regen, has also been added to regenerate the shop.cfg file in the config directory (please use this command after updating to ensure the product list is up to date).

A series of new items have been added (for both normal mode and skyblock mode). If you want to use the skyblock item list, please set skyblock_mode=true in shop.cfg. All these items have been carefully balanced and tested. Combining this mod with the Skyblock Mod will be very interesting! Additionally, in skyblock mode, players will have more diverse ways to earn money. Animal spawn eggs have also been added so that players can obtain and breed animals as usual.

You can add custom items to the shop in config/shop.cfg. Use the following format to add them:

id[:meta]=buy price,sell price
or
modid:name[:meta]=buy price,sell price
All items registered in the game are supported, including those from other mods.
For more details, please refer to the explanations in the cfg file.

Shop-BTW-CE3.X Quick Guide (English)

**Overview**  
Shop & global marketplace mod for BTW CE 3.x. Supports server shop, player listings, persistent balances, NBT item trading, global announcements, localization, custom hotkeys.

**Getting Started**  
1. Install to server mods folder and restart.
2. Set prices in `config/shop.cfg` (`id[:meta]=buy,sell`, e.g. `minecraft:diamond=100,50`).
3. Global listings saved in `config/global_shop.cfg` (no manual edits needed).
4. Client auto-localizes chat messages with parameters.

**Commands**
- `/shop` : Open system shop
- `/shop reload` : Reload price list
- `/gshop` : Open global market
- `/gshop sell <price> [amount]` : List item in hand
- `/gshop my` : Show own listings
- `/gshop unlist <id>` : Remove listing & refund
- `/money` : Show balance
- `/money <amount>` : OP set own balance

**Features**
- System shop: batch buy/sell, server-set prices
- Global marketplace: player listings, NBT support, self-trade protected
- Economy: one-decimal currency, persistent balance & listings
- Chat: auto-localized transaction info
- Press M to open the mailbox and receive goods.



Shop-BTW-CE3.X 使用教程（简体中文）

**简介**  
适用于 BTW CE 3.x 的商店与全球市场插件，可用于服主价格表和玩家自由交易，支持余额、NBT物品、全局公告、本地化、多热键。

**快速上手**  
1. 安装到服务器 mods 文件夹，重启服。
2. 配置价格：编辑 `config/shop.cfg`，格式 `id[:meta]=买价,卖价`，如 `minecraft:diamond=100,50`。
3. 全局市场持久化：`config/global_shop.cfg`，无需手动编辑。
4. 客户端支持本地化，自动替换参数显示。

**指令简表**
- `/shop` ：打开系统商店
- `/shop reload` ：重载价格表
- `/gshop` ：打开全球市场
- `/gshop sell <价格> [数量]` ：上架手中物品
- `/gshop my` ：显示自己的上架
- `/gshop unlist <id>` ：下架并返还物品
- `/money` ：显示余额
- `/money <金额>` ：OP设定自己余额

**特色**
- 系统商店支持批量买卖、按配置表定价
- 全球市场支持玩家自由上架/购买，保护NBT，禁止自买自卖
- 经济采用一位小数货币，余额与上架持久化
- 聊天自动本地化显示交易信息
- 按M键打开收件箱来接收来自全球商店的收购
